whyDifferent.heading: Why Los Angeles SEO Requires a Different Playbook
whyDifferent.intro: LA isn't one market — it's dozens of overlapping submarkets with distinct competitive dynamics:
items: eCommerce & D2C brands compete nationally, not just locally, meaning category and product page SEO has to hold up against every other online retailer, not just LA-based ones.
Real estate searches are hyper-local — "condos for sale in Culver City" behaves completely differently in Google's algorithm than "LA real estate agent."
Entertainment companies need content and digital PR strategies that build authoritative backlinks from industry press, not just directories.
Legal services in LA are some of the highest cost-per-click keywords in the country — $50–$200+ per click on Google Ads — making organic SEO a critical cost-reduction channel.
Consumer services (home services, personal services) live or die by the Google Map Pack and neighborhood-level local SEO.

regionsServed.heading: Los Angeles Neighborhoods & Submarkets We Optimize For
regionsServed.paragraph: "SEO agency Los Angeles" is really shorthand for dozens of distinct micro-markets. We build neighborhood-specific local SEO pages and Google Business Profile strategy for submarkets including Beverly Hills, Culver City, Silver Lake, Santa Monica, Downtown LA, Hollywood, West LA, Pasadena, Long Beach, and the San Fernando Valley — because a searcher looking for "real estate agent in Culver City" and one searching "real estate agent Los Angeles" have different intent, and Google treats them differently too.

mistakes: Competing citywide when you should compete neighborhood by neighborhood. Trying to rank one generic page for all of "Los Angeles" against thousands of competitors is far harder than owning specific submarkets first.

Underinvesting in link building for high-CPC industries. In legal and real estate, technical SEO and content alone rarely overcome entrenched competitors — authoritative backlinks are what break ties in LA's most competitive niches.
Ignoring page speed on mobile. LA's mobile search volume is enormous, and a slow-loading site directly suppresses both rankings and conversion rates.
Letting reviews stagnate. Consumer services and real estate businesses that stop actively generating Google reviews lose Map Pack visibility to competitors who don't.
